paxx.documented_limitation: Elegoo factory tag placement can read unreliably on Snapmaker U1

conclusion: Current source supports an implementation-level rule in which a single NTAG215 carrying only the ELEGOO CANVAS raw format is parsed by PAXX/OpenRFID when OpenRFID is selected and the disabled-by-default Elegoo processor is enabled. Stock Snapmaker U1 firmware is outside this rule. Physical CANVAS and U1/PAXX acceptance remains pending.
